HUD issue:

When there is a HUD bound to your character (when joining the player roster), entering TPV makes the HUD unstable. This also occurs in all Udon Sword worlds.

UX issue:

See: https://feedback.vrchat.com/third-person-view/p/1745-k-scroll-wheel-conflicts-with-tpv-camera-when-pickup-is-held

When holding the staff (or any item, in any world, for that matter), the scroll wheel will bring the item closer or further away, instead of move the TPV camera. I believe there should be an advanced option or toggle for this. F5 can still be pressed just fine, but the scroll wheel conflicts when an item is held.

Proximity issues:

-In Udon Sword 3, there is another instance where some proximity-based dialogue won't trigger unless in FPV, or really close up in TPV.

-[Not shown in video] In all Udon Sword games, desktop players must be a mage/healer. In Udon Sword 1, targeting other players with a healing or cure spell will instead target yourself in TPV.
title: [1745 K] Udon Sword (1/2/3) have HUD and proximity issues in TPV.
